sloka: अतिक्रम्य च सौमित्रिं कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः।राममेवाभिदुद्राव दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.६७.१०४ ।।
transliteration: atikramya ca saumitriṁ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ।rāmamevābhidudrāva dārayanniva medinīm ।। 6.67.104 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna having been tormented, put an end to the dart (of Lakshmana). Mighty Lakshmana there upon flew into a rage.
